idScheme: pp-NNN contiguous (pp-001..pp-052), ordered by dependency/milestone: backend Phase-B first, then frontend platform + set scaffold (m0), reference data (m1), consignment basics (m2), commodity capture (m3), details/review/submit (m4), m5 variant/deferred stubs. The original pp-001..pp-052 block is ordered so every dependsOn edge points at a strictly lower pp number; the pp-053+ block added by the 2026-08-01 co-residency re-plan breaks that numeric convention (pp-005/pp-006 depend on pp-053/pp-056/pp-057), so BUILD ORDER MUST BE READ FROM dependsOn, not from the id, and a topological sort is required. Target architecture is the SIBLING SET of live-animals per SIBLING-SET-PLAN.md — sets/plant-products/ CO-RESIDENT with live-animals in ONE Node process (ruling R3, 2026-08-01: both L1 gateways register, every configure* seam is keyed by set id, the request resolves its set from the owning plugin realm, live-animals keeps the root mount and plant-products mounts under /plant-products). There is NO boot-time SERVED_SET switch — that decision (SD-9/FD-1/FD-2/FD-4) is REVERSED. Not the standalone CDP app the source inc-001..inc-003 assumed either.

One enum round-trip test + one unknown-value negative test per enum, never per-constant tests. Runs under mvn test (Surefire).

entries.title: P-1: inject obligation-source policy via the set manifest (accessor functions — co-residency safe)
entries.planningBrief: AMENDED 2026-08-01 (ruling R3, co-residency). Move the four live-animals obligation-name literals (SYSTEM_POPULATED, ENFORCED_AT_CONTINUE, MAX_ENTRIES_FROM, SYSTEM_ANSWER_KEYS) out of L2 bridge/obligation-source.js and derive them from a policy export on the configured obligation-set manifest; sets/live-animals/obligations/index.js gains the policy export with today's values. THE EXPORT SHAPE IS NO LONGER THE PLANNER'S CALL: option (a) 'same export names as lazily-derived views' is DEAD, because a view resolves once per process while under co-residency the value differs per REQUEST — it would serve live-animals' ENFORCED_AT_CONTINUE to a plant request. P-1 takes option (b), accessor FUNCTIONS systemPopulated()/enforcedAtContinue()/maxEntriesFrom()/systemAnswerKeys(), which puts EVERY file in the 10-strong consumer list in scope; there is no smaller option and the size rises M→L. Acceptance: `grep -rn 'SYSTEM_POPULATED|ENFORCED_AT_CONTINUE|MAX_ENTRIES_FROM|SYSTEM_ANSWER_KEYS' src/server/app` returns NOTHING; full live-animals suite green unchanged; a unit test proving a different policy changes the derived surfaces; and a two-sets-in-one-process proof that they read DIFFERENT enforcedAtContinue values (unit level here, HTTP level handed to pp-006's co-residency.test.js). Now depends on pp-056 (P-9), since policy() reads the per-set obligation-set registry.
entries.rationale: Own increment: it is the single largest-blast-radius platform change (9+ consumer files) and a prerequisite for the plant manifest's policy export being honoured; combining it with anything else would blur the sibling-safety check.

entries.title: P-3: both gateways register in one process — routes.js becomes a barrel, routes-live-animals.js gains the set-context wiring, co-residency.test.js is born
entries.planningBrief: REWRITTEN 2026-08-01 (ruling R3). The old brief — 'rewrite routes.js as the SERVED_SET selector, the ONLY reader of the env var, and point router.js at servedSet()' — is deleted in full. There is NO selector, NO SETS map and NO served-set env var. Move the current routes.js body to routes-live-animals.js and give it the co-residency wiring: registerSetMount('live-animals',''), a realm-scoped onPreAuth enterSetContext extension, the whole register body wrapped in withSetContext('live-animals', …), setId as the first argument of all seven configure*/buildDispatch calls, and registerJourneyCookie(server, { base: '', cookieNames: SESSION_COOKIE_NAMES }). routes.js becomes a two-line BARREL re-exporting both gateways (one line until pp-007 lands the plant one); src/server/router.js keeps its live-animals registration and gains a SEPARATE server.register(plantProducts, { routes: { prefix: '/plant-products' } }) call at pp-007. This increment also CREATES src/server/app/co-residency.test.js with the live-animals half and a bootServer({ sets }) seam. Acceptance: the realm-scoping pin, the ALS-interleaving pin, byte-identical live-animals URLs with no spec edits, and `grep -rn 'SERVED_SET' .` EMPTY across the repo. Depends on pp-056 (P-9 — seams keyed) and pp-057 (P-10 — URLs namespaced).
entries.rationale: The gateway rework is a behaviour-preserving refactor of live-animals wiring, verifiable on its own against the existing suite before any plant code exists — and it is the increment that PROVES the co-residency mechanism (realm scoping + ALS interleaving), so it lands immediately after the seam keying and the URL namespace.

entries.title: Set scaffold: sets/plant-products/ m0 skeleton + routes-plant-products.js gateway + boot CO-RESIDENT (one process serves live-animals at / and plant-products under /plant-products)
entries.planningBrief: Re-interpretation of inc-001: not a CDP app scaffold but the sibling-set skeleton. Build the full §1 m0 file list — obligations/index.js (empty obligations, derived groups, FD-7 policy shape), coverage.test.js, journeys/linear/config.js (TEMPLATES/LAYOUT/plant cookie names, FD-3), flow/{flow,task-rows,run,entry-guard}.js (FLOW_ONLY_KEYS=['importType','declaration'] FD-8; sections=[start,review] FD-13/FD-12), features/{index,evaluation}.js, the import-type/dashboard/hub feature skeletons with copy bundles and e2e specs, services/mode.js (PLANT_PRODUCTS_MODE, FD-6), services/records/{index,stub}.js (in-memory stub satisfying the engine port so the app boots; real.js + mapper are pp-008), docs/README.md charter. Then routes-plant-products.js per the 14-row call table in §4.4.3 (order is load-bearing; registerSetMount + realm-scoped onPreAuth + withSetContext wrapper + setId as the first argument of every configure*/buildDispatch + per-set registerJourneyCookie(server, { base: '/plant-products', cookieNames }); no configureCommodityReference, no priming), the barrel's second export line, and a SEPARATE server.register(plantProducts, { routes: { prefix: '/plant-products' } }) in src/server/router.js. AMENDED 2026-08-01 (rulings R3, R6): definition of done is CO-RESIDENT — ONE process serves live-animals at / and plant-products under /plant-products, proven by extending co-residency.test.js with the plant half (both dashboards in one run, per-set cookies/manifests/records, cross-set realm scoping, cross-set ALS interleaving, divergent enforcedAtContinue, independent stub/real modes, prime() once). There is NO SERVED_SET. R6 also inverts this increment's relationship to the recipe: src/server/app/docs/add-a-set.md is authored FIRST by pp-053 and FOLLOWED VERBATIM here, each file citing the step it executes — it is no longer the source from which a recipe is later extracted.
entries.rationale: inc-001 (CDP scaffold) becomes the set scaffold + co-resident registration. Kept as ONE increment because the m0 file list is only verifiable as a whole (the gateway's configure chain needs every skeleton export to boot); the stub records impl is included because configureRecords is call 8 and boot fails without it.

entries.title: Set-owned records service: real REST adapter + mapper + copy idempotency against /plant-products/notifications
entries.planningBrief: Re-interpretation of inc-002: not a Mongo persistence spine but the set-owned records service (FD-5) completing services/records/ — real.js implementing the 11-op engine port against the Phase-B REST surface exactly per the op->HTTP table in §6.2 (create mints GBN-PP refs server-side, replaceFulfilment is whole-document PUT last-write-wins, status moves via PUT .../status, copy via POST .../copies, clear throws in real mode), plus mapper/to-dto.js and from-dto.js (camelCase DTO, server-set fields never sent; documents group projection onto the accompanying-documents sub-resource is FD-11 — naive replace acceptable, full detail owned by pp-034). Stub.js gains identical semantics including status-transition legality so the Playwright self-hosted ladder needs no backend. §8 G-D lists what the missing records-adapter recipe must cover — treat it as first-class plan content. P-2 containment acceptance applies: nothing plant imports services/persistence/records/. AMENDED 2026-08-01 (rulings R3, R4). (1) The records seam is KEYED BY SET — configureRecords takes setId — so 'the plant impl is the one resolved for plant requests while live-animals resolves its own, in one process' becomes provable and is pinned in co-residency.test.js; the P-2 claim likewise strengthens, because the plant slot of configureCommodityReference is provably ABSENT rather than overwritten, so a plant request reaching the L2 mapper throws loudly (negative test) instead of mapping with live-animals vocabulary. (2) R4 LANDS HERE, NOT WITH THE COPY BUTTON: copy POSTs to /plant-products/notifications/{ref}/copies with a REQUIRED Idempotency-Key header — real.js sends it (and rejects a blank key locally), stub.js mirrors it with a dedupe key scoped to `${sourceReference}:${key}`, and records-port.test.js pins 'one new draft per idempotency key' and 'copy idempotency scoped to the source reference'. Transpose the live-animals pattern (which sits on the FULFILMENT resource) onto the NOTIFICATION resource — pattern, not code. The backend half is pp-054; note the overlap with pp-055, which must be folded in or narrowed before build (recorded in pp-008's openQuestions).
entries.rationale: inc-002 (Mongo spine) becomes the records adapter because persistence is the backend's job now; split from pp-007 so the scaffold's boot (stub mode) is verifiable before the REST client + mapper land, and because this increment carries its own contract risk against the backend.

entries.title: Flow/session spine: entry-guard + opening-run + draft save/resume through the set
entries.planningBrief: Re-interpretation of inc-003: the page-owned routing/validation spine already exists in L2 — this increment proves and completes the SET's flow/session behaviour. Flesh out entry-guard.js (fresh deep-links redirect to the import-type filter — §8 G-E lists the policy contract: what entryGuardTarget may return, allowed L2 reads), run.js RUN_STEPS (import-type only at m0), the three plant session cookies riding configureSession, and flow-only answers (importType, declaration — FD-8) in session. Prove draft resume end-to-end: create via import-type -> persisted through the records service -> re-entry rehydrates. Records once, for all downstream pages, that validation is single-layer Joi-voice per c-018 and error rendering is GDS 'There is a problem' + legend-as-heading per c-004/c-014 (these are L2-free defaults, not per-page work). AMENDED 2026-08-01 (ruling R3): this increment now sits DOWNSTREAM of the session-seam rework. By the time it runs the three exported mutable cookie-name bindings are accessor functions (pp-056), and the plant cookies carry path '/plant-products' via the per-set registerJourneyCookie — so 'a journey started in one set is invisible to the other' becomes a testable claim and is now an acceptance criterion plus an E2E scenario. The entry guard is realm-scoped and must be SHOWN not to fire on live-animals routes (and vice versa). Most important: the set's entry-guard must build its journey prefix from setBase() as a FUNCTION, never a module-load const — the live-animals JOURNEY_PREFIX bug class that pp-057 exists to remove.
entries.rationale: inc-003 becomes the flow/session spine for the set: the skeleton files exist from pp-007 but their POLICY behaviour (guard redirects, opening run, save/resume round-trip) is a separately verifiable unit that needs the real records adapter underneath it.

entries.title: P-4 + P-5 + T-1/T-2/T-3/T-5: dep-cruiser rules + cloned/parameterised app-root suites + test:plant-products script
entries.planningBrief: One increment covering the Vitest/dep-cruiser scaffolding family: P-4 (.dependency-cruiser.cjs routes-is-the-gateway pathNot gains both routes-*.js files; sets-not-l1 forbids sets importing any routes-*.js; violations baseline NOT regenerated), T-1 (test:plant-products npm script), T-2 (parameterise copy-convention/copy-parity fs-walk tests over both set roots in-file — FD-10), T-3 (clone the singleton-composing app-root suites as *.plant-products.test.js: contract, routes, indexed, store-ops, one-load-per-request-if-set-composing), T-5 (contract.plant-products.test.js harness with zero cases; standing rule that every collecting controller adds its valid-POST case). Acceptance: every plant variant green against the m0 skeleton, live-animals originals untouched, no existing-suite test-count drop, deliberate probe import fails the dep-cruiser rule. AMENDED 2026-08-01 (ruling R3): the sets-not-l1 forbidden-target regex widens to name BOTH new gateway filenames — ^APP/(routes|routes-live-animals|routes-plant-products|obligation-purity)\.js$ — and routes.js STAYS whitelisted on routes-is-the-gateway even though it is now a pure barrel. shared/set-context.js needs NO rule (ordinary L2, imports nothing under sets/). The CLONE RATIONALE changes: the old justification (vitest file isolation dodges the single slots) is dead because pp-056 keyed every seam; FD-17's sole-registered-set fallback means each clone composes one set and needs NO withSetContext plumbing, so the clones are mechanical set swaps with setId supplied as the first argument of every configure*/buildDispatch. The one file needing explicit context is co-residency.test.js, which is not a clone.
entries.rationale: Grouped per the plan's own hint: P-4 and P-5/T-1..T-3/T-5 are all small config/clone edits verified by the same two commands (npm run lint:arch + the vitest suites) and individually too thin to be increments. Must land before the first obligation-bearing page (§9 rule 2).

entries.title: T-6: per-set Playwright feature project + test:features:all (both sets, one server) as the E2E co-residency proof
entries.planningBrief: AMENDED 2026-08-01 (ruling R3). The 'webServer env pass-through' half of the old brief is a NON-PROBLEM and is dropped: there is no SERVED_SET to smuggle through Playwright's env merge, so the config comment the old brief mandated is not written. What replaces it: (a) NEW Playwright project features-plant-products (testDir under sets/plant-products, testMatch '**/*.e2e.spec.js', same use block as features) whose specs navigate to /plant-products/… while live-animals specs are UNEDITED; (b) NEW npm script test:features:plant-products = build:frontend + PLANT_PRODUCTS_MODE=stub only (it selects the plant records stub, not a set); (c) ONE edit to the shared webServer block — add PLANT_PRODUCTS_MODE: 'stub' alongside LIVE_ANIMALS_MODE: 'stub'; (d) NEW test:features:all running BOTH projects in a single invocation against a single server, as the E2E-level co-residency proof and the counterpart to co-residency.test.js. Acceptance: the m0 import-type + hub + dashboard specs pass under the new script; at least one asserts plant-set content that cannot render under live-animals (a MOUNT proof now, not an env proof); / still serves the live-animals dashboard in the same run; existing test:features untouched and green; test:features:all green.
entries.rationale: Separate from pp-010 because it is a different toolchain (Playwright vs Vitest/dep-cruiser) with a load-bearing env-pass-through subtlety the round-1 plan got wrong; its acceptance needs the pp-007 e2e specs.

entries.title: P-7: depth-3 nested-collection characterisation test (GATE for all m3 work)
entries.planningBrief: An L2-fixture characterisation test composing a synthetic 3-deep manifest (lines -> species -> varieties) and exercising: grouped-binding registration at depth 3, appendEntryAt/updateEntryAt/removeEntryAt at ['lines', i, 'species', j, 'varieties'], per-instance scope + wipe at depth 3, collection-complete rollup, and dispatch coverage inheritance from the nearest ancestor group. Pattern: the existing bridge characterisation tests that compose a set as fixture. GREEN means the m3 commodity increments proceed on the platform as-is; ANY RED raises a NEW platform work item before pp-021 (which is already a halt-for-review gate). §8 G-B explains why: the live exemplar (animalIdentifiers) is only depth 2, so depth 3 is unproven platform ground.
entries.rationale: The single riskiest platform unknown gets its own gate increment BEFORE any m3 commodity work (the plan's loudest sequencing constraint, §9 rule 1). Pure L2 fixture work, so no dependency on the plant set itself.

entries.title: Draft lifecycle — delete, amend, copy-as-new
entries.ruling: Soft-delete (status -> DELETED, own URL scheme — do not port the /notification/vnet prefix, c-028); amend transitions SUBMITTED -> AMEND capturing a submittedBaseline snapshot (house parity); copy-as-new clones into a fresh DRAFT (documentless — D-19). All reuse the backend status transitions via the pp-008 records ops (amend, cancelAmend, copy, softDelete); no ETag/If-Match. delete-notification page + notification-actions per the §1 [m5] feature dirs; §8 G-G: plan by transposing the live-animals notification-actions/delete-notification exemplars. split-consignment-confirm OUT (post-submission). **R4 (Sam, 2026-08-01) — THE COPY BUTTON MUST NOT SHIP BEFORE COPY IDEMPOTENCY EXISTS.** The Idempotency-Key contract and its records-port contract tests are NOT this increment's: the frontend adapter half (real.js sends the header, stub.js dedupes on `${sourceReference}:${key}`, records-port.test.js pins 'one new draft per idempotency key' and 'copy idempotency scoped to the source reference') belongs to pp-008, and the backend half (required @RequestHeader, copyIdempotencyKey + unique partial index 'copy_idempotency_key', service lookup-then-return-existing) belongs to pp-054 — hence the new dependsOn. THIS increment mints only the UI half, mirroring live-animals exactly: a randomUUID() per RENDERED copy action (live-animals does it in features/dashboard/view-model/row/actions.js and features/check-answers/controller.js), carried in a hidden input named idempotencyKey, passed through copyJourney(request, h, journeyId, idempotencyKey). Note the transposition: live-animals implements idempotency on the FULFILMENT resource, whereas the plant-products design puts /copies on the NOTIFICATION resource — transpose the pattern, not the code. R5 stands: this remains an UNPLANNED m5 stub; the constraint is recorded here so whoever plans it cannot ship a non-idempotent Copy button.
